item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
[Image: Shaded rectangular diagram that is x meters by x plus 4 meters. A white, width-wise rectangular path goes down the middle of the diagram and is 1 meter by x meters.]

This is a diagram of a rectangular garden.

The white area is a rectangular path that is 1 meter wide.

Which expression shows the area of the shaded portion of the garden in m^2?
item.figure_description: A rectangle with height labeled x m and total width labeled (x + 4) m. The rectangle is divided vertically into three sections: a shaded gray rectangular region on the left, a vertical white rectangular strip labeled "path" in the middle, and another shaded gray rectangular region on the right. An arrow beneath the white path indicates its width is 1 m.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.stem:
A rectangular garden that is next to a building has a path around the other three sides, as shown.

Directly adjacent to the building wall is a shaded rectangular "Garden", surrounded on the remaining three sides by an unshaded "Path" forming a larger outer rectangle. The dimensions shown are: total vertical height of the outer rectangle along the building wall is 12 m; horizontal length of the garden is 10 m; vertical height of the garden is 8 m; and total horizontal width of the outer rectangle (garden plus path width) along the bottom is 12 m.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem: Which of these could represent the expression 2x + 3x?

options.label: A
options.text: The length of this segment: [Image: X and 5 are segment lengths on a number line, and the segment length of 5 is slightly larger than the segment length of x.]

options.label: B
options.text: The length of this segment: [Image: 2, 3, and x are segment lengths on a number line. The segment length of 2 is the smallest. The segment length of 3 is around twice the length of 2, and the segment length of x is almost three times the length of 2.]

options.label: C
options.text: The area of this figure: [Image: A rectangle, where one side of the rectangle is labeled “x” and the other side is divided, with the smaller part labeled 2, and the larger part other labeled 3.]

options.label: D
options.text: The area of this figure: [Image: A rectangle, with one side is labeled 5 and the other side is divided in two equal parts, with each part labeled with “x”.]

reference_items.figure_description:
Four options showing visual representations:
- Option A shows a horizontal line segment with vertical tick marks at its ends, divided into two segments by an interior vertical tick mark. The segment on the left is labeled x above, and the segment on the right is labeled 5 above.
- Option B shows a horizontal line segment with vertical tick marks at its ends, divided into three segments by two interior vertical tick marks. From left to right, the segments are labeled 2, 3, and x above.
- Option C shows a rectangle with its left vertical side labeled x. A vertical dotted line extends through the rectangle, dividing the top horizontal side into two parts, labeled 2 on the left and 3 on the right.
- Option D shows a rectangle with its left vertical side labeled 5. A vertical dotted line extends through the rectangle, dividing the top horizontal side into two equal parts, each labeled x above.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem: Which picture shows that 2/5 is equivalent to 4/10 ?

options.label: C
options.text: [Image: 2-by-5 grid with 5 squares shaded in a checkerboard pattern]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image: Rectangle with 2 solid circles and 3 open circles]

reference_items.figure_description:
Four labeled options (A, B, C, D):
- Option A shows a rectangle divided into a 2-by-5 grid of 10 equal squares. The two squares in the first column and the two squares in the fifth column are completely shaded black (4 of 10 squares shaded).
- Option B shows a rectangle divided into a 2-by-5 grid of 10 equal squares. The top-left square (row 1, column 1) and bottom-right square (row 2, column 5) are shaded black (2 of 10 squares shaded).
- Option C shows a rectangle divided into a 2-by-5 grid of 10 equal squares. In the top row, the 1st, 3rd, and 5th squares are shaded black; in the bottom row, the 2nd and 4th squares are shaded black (5 of 10 squares shaded in a checkerboard pattern).
- Option D shows a rectangular box containing five small circles scattered inside: two circles are solid black and three circles are open white circles with a black outline.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: A rectangular prism, with a length of 5 blocks, width of 4 blocks, and height of 3 blocks. There is a hole shown on the top of the rectangular prism. The hole is 2 blocks by 3 blocks and goes all the way through the shape.]

The figure above shows a shape made up of cubes that are all the same size. There is a hole all the way through the shape. How many cubes would be needed to fill the hole?
reference_items.figure_description: An isometric drawing of a 3D block shape constructed from identical unit cubes. The overall block is 5 cubes wide along the front, 4 cubes deep along the right side, and 3 cubes tall. In the center of the top face, there is a rectangular rectangular hole measuring 3 cubes wide by 2 cubes deep, bordered by a rim that is 1 cube wide on all four sides. The hole extends vertically straight down through the entire height of 3 cubes.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data.

The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
